board: Ground: verified local resources, Jersey City, NJ

checks.result: Confirmed on the provider home page: groceries on the third Saturday of each month, 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m., no one turned away while food lasts, and the page footer gives 440 Hoboken Avenue, Jersey City, NJ 07306.

Confirmed on the provider food pantry page: pantry run by the Ruth Missionary Society, open every third Saturday, 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. The page states no street address, so the listing says so plainly.

Confirmed on the Catholic Charities page: supervised shelter open 24 hours a day, seven days a week, 150 beds, single men and women over 21, three meals a day, at 619 Grove Street, Jersey City, NJ 07310.

Confirmed on the Catholic Charities page: emergency family shelter for up to 20 families with three meals a day and referral routes, at 246 Second Street, Jersey City, NJ 07302. The page states no hours, so the listing says so plainly.
Confirmed on the Catholic Charities page: the shelter offers showers and runs a drop-in center during the week from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. at 619 Grove Street, Jersey City, NJ 07310.
Confirmed on the provider contact page: the Garfield Avenue site in Jersey City lists its weekly hours, its services, and sliding fee scale discounts, at 935 Garfield Avenue, Jersey City, NJ.

Confirmed on the provider site: the home page gives 115 Christopher Columbus Drive, Jersey City, NJ 07302 and hours Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. and Saturday 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., and the provider services page states sliding scale fees with no one turned away for inability to pay.

drops.reason: Provider own site does not state the drop-in address or hours. Those details appear only on a City of Jersey City page, which is not the provider own page.
Provider pantry page could not be fetched today, and the pantry text available from the provider site states no street address.

City page states transport runs in winter Code Blue emergencies and links out for hours. No set times are stated on the page itself.

expiry_rule: Every listing expires 30 days after the date it was verified. A listing past its expiry is shown as stale, never silently.

listings.offer: Free groceries for people in the greater Hudson County area. No one is turned away as long as food lasts. Bring ID and proof of enrolled programs if you have them.
listings.when: Third Saturday of each month, 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m., or until food runs out.

listings.offer: Community food pantry run by the Ruth Missionary Society, providing food to families and individuals in the community.
listings.when: Every third Saturday, 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.
listings.where: Address not stated on the provider food pantry page.

listings.offer: Emergency shelter for single men and women over age 21 from Hudson County. 150 beds in total. Three meals a day, clothing, case management and outreach services.
listings.provider: St. Lucy's Emergency Shelter, Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Newark
listings.when: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week, year round.

listings.offer: Emergency shelter for homeless Hudson County families, up to 20 families. Three meals a day, case management, food and clothing. Families are referred from Hudson County Division of Social Services or the Garden State Episcopal coordinated entry program.
listings.provider: Hope House, Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Newark
listings.when: Hours not stated on the provider page.

listings.offer: Showers and a weekday drop-in center for Hudson County residents without an address, with groups, workshops and a computer station for job search and resumes.
listings.provider: St. Lucy's Emergency Shelter, Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Newark
listings.when: Drop-in center weekdays, 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Separate shower hours not stated on the provider page.

listings.offer: Community health center care including internal medicine, pediatrics, women's health, behavioral health, dental, laboratory and pharmacy. Sliding fee scale discounts are listed on the provider page.
listings.when: Monday and Tuesday, 8:30 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Wednesday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Second and fourth Saturday of each month, 8:30 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.

listings.offer: Federally qualified health center. Primary, pediatric, dental and behavioral health services. The provider services page states all services are available on a sliding scale fee and no one is turned away regardless of ability to pay.
listings.when: Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Saturday, 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
